result.analyst_notes: Confident, promotional tone with absolute claims such as world leader and unmatched. Mostly factual business description with headcount and revenue. Customers are addressed first through a mission statement framed as enabling customer outcomes. Uses first-person plural we. Societal benefit appears only as a broad mission phrase, with no hedged or specific commitments.
